name: 童书彩虹
description: 童书插画感：奶白 #FFFDF2 + 多彩四色（粉 #FF9AA2/桃 #FFB7B2/芒果 #FFDAC1/薄荷 #B5EAD7/天蓝 #C7CEEA）循环。H1 粉色大胶囊+白字、H2 桃色方块、H3 薄荷绿左条、blockquote 芒果底+天蓝字、hr 彩虹条。亲子童真派（vs pastel 单一柔紫，vs memphis 锋利跳跃）。适合儿童教育/育儿/亲子/轻松随笔。

styles.h1: font-size: 26px; font-weight: 700; color: #FFFFFF; text-align: center; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 36px; margin-bottom: 28px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#FF9AA2 0%,#FFB7B2 100%); border-radius: 999px; letter-spacing: 2px; box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(255,154,162,0.35);
styles.h2: font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; color: #FFFFFF; line-height: 1.4; margin-top: 30px; margin-bottom: 16px; background: #FFB7B2; border-radius: 14px; display: inline-block; letter-spacing: 1px; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px rgba(255,183,178,0.30);
styles.h3: font-size: 17px; font-weight: 700; color: #3A3A3A; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 26px; margin-bottom: 12px; border-left: 6px solid #B5EAD7; background: rgba(181,234,215,0.20); border-radius: 0 8px 8px 0;
styles.h4: font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #C7CEEA; line-height: 1.5; margin-top: 22px; margin-bottom: 10px; letter-spacing: 0.5px;
styles.h5: font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #6A6A6A; margin-top: 18px; margin-bottom: 8px; line-height: 1.5;
styles.h6: font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; color: #999999; margin-top: 16px; margin-bottom: 6px; line-height: 1.5; letter-spacing: 1.5px;
styles.p: font-size: 16px; color: #3A3A3A; line-height: 1.9; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 16px; letter-spacing: 0.3px;
styles.blockquote: background: #FFDAC1; border-radius: 16px; margin-top: 24px; margin-bottom: 24px; font-size: 15px; color: #6A4A3A; line-height: 1.8; border-left: none; box-shadow: inset 4px 0 0 #C7CEEA;
styles.blockquote p: font-size: 15px; color: #6A4A3A; line-height: 1.8; margin-bottom: 0; background: transparent;
styles.img: max-width: 100%; display: block; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; border-radius: 20px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(255,154,162,0.2); background: transparent;
styles.hr: margin-top: 32px; margin-bottom: 32px; height: 6px; border: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg,#FF9AA2 0 20%,#FFDAC1 20% 40%,#FFD700 40% 60%,#B5EAD7 60% 80%,#C7CEEA 80% 100%); border-radius: 3px;
styles.code: background: #FFE5E5; border-radius: 8px; font-size: 92%; color: #FF9AA2; font-family: 'SF Mono','Menlo',monospace; font-weight: 600;
styles.pre: background: #FFFFFF; border: 2px solid #B5EAD7; border-radius: 16px; margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(181,234,215,0.25); color: #3A3A3A; overflow-x: auto; font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.7; white-space: pre-wrap;
styles.pre::before: display: flex; align-items: center; height: 32px; background: #B5EAD7; color: #3A3A3A; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1px;
styles.pre code: background: none; color: #3A3A3A; font-size: 13px; font-family: 'SF Mono','Menlo',monospace;
styles.table: width: 100%; border-collapse: separate; border-spacing: 0; margin-top: 20px; margin-bottom: 20px; font-size: 14px; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 6px 16px rgba(255,154,162,0.12);
styles.ul li::marker: color: #FFFFFF; background: #FF9AA2; margin-right: 10px; font-weight: 700; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 12px;
styles.ol li::marker: display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 24px; height: 24px; min-width: 24px; background: linear-gradient(135deg,#B5EAD7,#C7CEEA); color: #3A3A3A; border-radius: 50%; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 700; margin-right: 10px; margin-top: 2px;
styles.li: font-size: 16px; color: #3A3A3A; line-height: 1.9; display: flex; margin-bottom: 8px; align-items: flex-start;
